vram_budget_revision: After unbounded long01 showed >5GiB WDDM shared memory at S8192, cap allocator at driver physical free minus 512MiB; retain old group as residency-invalid diagnostic, not resident-GPU benchmark

fp16_reference_group.reason: BF16 short03 failed frozen max_abs/relative_l2; separate FP16 activation group, no threshold relaxation
fp16_reference_group.weights: official BF16 weights exactly cast to FP16

candidate_matrix.activations: symmetric INT8 [-127,127] dynamic per token row
candidate_matrix.output: FP32 dequantization then BF16, original bias
candidate_matrix.scale: FP32 W/channel A/token; no integer M/r requantization
candidate_matrix.excluded: embedding, tied LM head, convolution, attention QK/PV, recurrent and nonlinear remain native float

state_quantization: symmetric per tensor/head last 2 axes; RNE; dequantize to original dtype after each cached call; fake quant only, not integer update

performance.timing: CUDA synchronized wall time, prefill/decode/end to end separately; no tokenization/loading
